# Generated by the ZIN content builder (modules/events_world.mjs) from tools/content/data/events_world*.json. Do not edit.
# One start-up block: the flavour of the first year is scheduled once per country, a few hours after the start so that every other
# start-up block (regional flags, people, cultures) has run. The global flag keeps a reloaded game from scheduling twice.
on_actions = {
	on_startup = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_lore_started } }
				set_global_flag = zin_lore_started
				every_country = {
					country_event = { id = zin_lore.100 hours = 2 }
				}
				random_country = {
					country_event = { id = zin_lore.20 hours = 3 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
